status: Implemented and validated; broader evaluator admission remains open
change: Optional MemoryScope propagates through recursive row expressions. Call and IN argument arrays are admitted before construction. Row string casts and replacement reuse the vector-path admission helpers. Aggregate input expressions execute inside a per-value child scope through state consumption, then release temporaries on success or failure. Column-only aggregate updates avoid child scopes and iterate the existing state record without Object.entries arrays.

cases: Nested bigint cast and Unicode replacement tokens match native results
Exact retained extent succeeds; one byte short rejects
1000 aggregate rows release temporary allocations between inputs
Expanding replacement rejects during scanning and closes source with zero retained budget
validation.remote: Actual R2 HTTP 206 fixture, four concurrent jobs, cold/warm cache, 64/128 MiB shared pools and 8 MiB query caps. Aggregate expression counts match independent non-null fixture counts before and after checkpoint resume. Peak tracked allocation 424491 bytes; retained cache 5481; eviction zero.

limits: Remaining row scalar operations (including casing, regex, date and spatial operations), comparisons and HAVING/projection call sites still require allocation coverage. Optional scope is not a claim that every evaluator operation is admitted.
Small remote fixture establishes operation, not throughput improvement or total runtime heap bounds.
Six previously recorded Parquet conformance failures remain unresolved; this change does not assert release acceptance.
